algebra_verified: h_ab = -(2 kappa4^2/p^2)(T_ab - T eta_ab/2) with kappa4^2 = 8 pi G4, G4 = 2 k+ k- G5/(k- - k+)
scope: arXiv:2001.07433 sec. 3.1 uses the Lorentzian 4-momentum p^2 = -p0^2 + |p|^2 and includes the wall bending F, which converts the 5D tensor structure (T - T eta/3) into the 4D one (T - T eta/2). So at p << a k the full linear response to time-dependent sources is linearized 4D GR with G4, not only the static Newtonian limit of 1807.01570.
sign: The physical positive source is -Sigma (wall matter enters negative and is overcompensated by bulk string pull), as the paper states.
matter_content: String endpoints act as point particles of mass tau/k on the wall (2001.07433 eq. near line 170): dust. Worldvolume EM radiation gravitates as 4D radiation after backreaction (2310.15032 sec. 4.2).
remaining: Flat-background result: corrections O(p/(a k)) and, on an FRW wall, O(H/k). The endpoints' own equations of motion are taken as point-particle (dust) dynamics; deriving them from the string action is not done here.
status_change: Phase 2 open item 2 (matter sector) moves from [O] to [D] at leading order in p/(a k) and H/k.
